description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order to restrict access by the Public to or from the Piliyandala Bypass, Under the Notional Throughfares  Act
categorisation: This gazette content is an order issued under Section 86 of The National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008, which restricts public access to the Piliyandala Bypass. It represents a regulatory action based on existing legislation, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of the minister's name is incidental to the legal order being issued, not the primary focus of the gazette.
